rows.role_title: 委員長 / 党首 — chair of the Japan Socialist Party and, from its 1996 renaming, the Social Democratic Party
rows.text: The page reports that 社民党の福島みずほ党首 stated her intention to resign at the standing committee on the 25th.

rows.role_title: 委員長 / 党首 — chair of the Japan Socialist Party and, from its 1996 renaming, the Social Democratic Party
rows.text: At the standing executive committee on the 25th 福島みずほ党首 stated her intention to resign, taking responsibility for the defeats in the general election and the House of Councillors election.

rows.role_title: 委員長 / 党首 — chair of the Japan Socialist Party and, from its 1996 renaming, the Social Democratic Party
rows.text: The standing committee accepted 福島みずほ党首's stated intention and confirmed that an acting leader (党首代行) would be appointed until a new leader was chosen.

rows.role_title: 委員長 / 党首 — chair of the Japan Socialist Party and, from its 1996 renaming, the Social Democratic Party
rows.text: At the press conference that followed, 福島党首 said she was taking responsibility for the defeats and resigning as of today ('本日で辞任する').

rows.role_title: 委員長 / 党首 — chair of the Japan Socialist Party and, from its 1996 renaming, the Social Democratic Party
rows.text: The page adds that 福島党首 became leader in November 2003 as 土井たか子党首's successor and was afterwards re-elected unopposed in five consecutive leader elections.
